race.comment: AMERICANGODDYJUJON (3) finished second last start over 1780m at this track, beaten 23 metres, after also filling a minor placing at the previous appearance over 1780m at this track. Will enjoy a nice run from this favourable starting position. Meets a comparable field and she can figure in the finish. BIG TINY (2) resumes. Last appeared when a modest tenth over 1660m at Albion Park 19 months ago. MAJOR CIARA (4) is the best of the rest after finishing sixth over 1660m at Albion Park last time out. SWEET CHARMER (1) gets the ace draw for the return so may be worth keeping safe.
